confidence: 97.5% task-cluster bootstrap per agent; Bonferroni across two agents
positive_evidence: selected skill changed, positive interval lower bound and paired randomization p < .025
selection: strict validation improvement, no critical regressions, tool ratio <=1.5
cost_policy: existing subscriptions only; no API inference; measured tokens and reported CLI costs, aggregate USD unknown
failure_policy: Completed write violations score zero. Invalid model-authored proposals are retained as rejected; the loop continues with its last valid skill. Authentication, malformed runner JSON and execution failures remain fatal. Final outcomes never feed back into selection.

The first study was interrupted during validation and never exposed final tasks.
